seed_fields.description: Maximize held-out empirical F1 independently for each score column. Nonempty finite float64 scores (N,L) in [0,1] and aligned int64 binary labels are required; every column must contain both classes. Predictions use score >= threshold. Among equal computed float64 F1 values, choose the highest observed-score threshold. Tied scores are processed together. Returns a new float64 vector (L,); inputs are unchanged. Sorting takes O(L*N*log(N)) time and O(N) temporary memory per column. Caller must enforce training/calibration/query separation. This fits a decision threshold, not calibrated probabilities or unbiased accuracy. No expected-F1 approximation, class weighting or domain policy is used.

seed_fields.description: Softmax-weighted reduction of values (B,T,F) over valid positions. Logits (B,T) share the floating dtype and device of values; mask is boolean (B,T) on the same device. Dimensions are nonempty, every row has a valid position, and valid values/logits must be finite. Masked entries may be nonfinite: they are replaced before arithmetic and receive zero gradient. Returns pooled values (B,F) and weights (B,T), preserving autograd, dtype and device. Inputs are unchanged. No score model, position encoding, training, padding generation or application-specific policy is included.

seed_fields.description: Consume numeric mappings once and return fitted vocabulary and CSR rows. Accepts a nonempty iterable, including a one-shot generator, of mappings from nonempty string keys to finite real values (booleans excluded). Signed and zero values are accepted. Empty rows are allowed but the total feature vocabulary must be nonempty. Columns use sorted feature names. Returns a fitted sklearn DictVectorizer and float64 CSR matrix in input row order. Source mappings are validated and copied one at a time, never materialized as a full list. The output CSR and vocabulary remain resident. Caller owns training/query separation and must not mutate fitted state between calls. No categorical encoding, labels, scaling or application policy is imposed.

seed_fields.description: Fit L2 binary logistic regression using LBFGS and an intercept. Features are a nonempty canonical float64 scipy CSR matrix; aligned int64 labels (N,) contain both 0 and 1. C (inverse regularization) and tolerance are finite positive Python numbers; maximum_iterations is a positive Python int and seed is a Python int in [0,2**32). Controls are caller supplied. No feature scaling, weighting, class balancing or split policy is imposed. Returns a fitted sklearn LogisticRegression. Nonconvergence raises rather than returning a partial fit. Native thread pools are limited to one during fitting; caller owns aggregate concurrency. A sparse copy protects input storage. Fitted coefficients remain dense; source features are not densified.
